test_title: SSC CGL Tier 2 English Previous Paper 1 (Held On: 29 Jan 2022)
subject: english
question:
**Select the option that expresses the given sentence in direct speech.**

She asked if she could help him with his packing.

options.text: She said, “May I help you with your packing?”
She said, “Can I help you with your packing?”
She said, “Could I help him with your packing?”
She said, “Should you help me with my packing?”

solution:
​The correct answer is **She said, “Can I help you with your packing?”**
